purpose: single-switch synthetic association ablation, not a production default change
hypothesis: Disabling only the xyah Mahalanobis rejection gate may reduce shape-pulse fragmentation without increasing association or counting errors; this may fail.

grid.ordering: registered scenario order, seed order, condition order, variant order

evaluation.pairing: identical immutable detections, no truth features, separate tracker instances
evaluation.primary: mean ID switches per reference object over all seeds and the two box-error conditions, separately per scenario
evaluation.acceptance: all nonincrease gates in every paired case and improvement margins in at least two of three scenarios, independently in each split
evaluation.no_effect: complete valid data with no paired difference in any registered endpoint
evaluation.failure: any safety-gate regression, or complete valid adequately challenged nonzero-effect data missing an improvement margin
evaluation.inconclusive: incomplete or invalid evidence, or fewer than two scenarios with baseline primary at least the minimum, in either split
evaluation.null_policy: retain undefined values and their counts; never replace with zero
evaluation.inference: descriptive scenario-specific evidence only; no pooled site estimate, p-value or confidence interval

execution_policy.heldout_policy: one complete registered grid; exclusive opening claim; stop on first error; retain partial evidence; no selective reruns
execution_policy.invalidity_policy: stop and document a versioned amendment; do not silently replace seeds or revive an opened holdout
